items.t: Fuel pump outlet hose may come loose (recall)
items.job: Reattach or replace fuel pump outlet hose and clamp
items.note: Covered free under recall 02V-245 for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask an Infiniti dealer.

items.t: Stalling from crank or cam sensor failure
items.job: Replace crankshaft and camshaft position sensors
items.note: Some years were covered by recall 03V-455. Check your VIN first. A single sensor costs less.
Covered free under recall 05V-555 for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask an Infiniti dealer.

items.t: Timing chain guide and tensioner wear
items.job: Replace timing chain guides and tensioners
items.note: Many shops replace the chains at the same time. Cost rises if cam sprockets or the engine are damaged.

items.job: Replace both front compression rods and align
items.note: Price covers both sides plus an alignment. Bushing-only kits cost less in parts but take more labor.

items.job: Four-wheel alignment and two new front tires
items.note: Fix worn compression rods first or the new tires will wear the same way.

items.t: Premature front brake wear and squeal
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Cars with the Brembo sport brakes use costlier pads and rotors.

items.job: Inspect and repair passenger seat sensor wiring
items.note: Covered free under recall 10V-175 for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask an Infiniti dealer.

items.job: Replace or reprogram occupant classification control unit
items.note: Covered free under recall 08V-521 for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask an Infiniti dealer.
Ask a dealer about goodwill help first. A fitted dash cover is a far cheaper fix for the glare.

items.job: Replace oil gallery gaskets behind the timing cover
items.note: High parts figure includes the timing chain kit and water pump many shops replace at the same time.

items.job: Replace electronic steering lock unit and program it
items.note: A new lock must be programmed to the car, so this is usually a dealer or specialist job.

items.job: Replace passenger seat occupant classification sensor
items.note: The sensor often comes as part of the seat cushion assembly, which drives up the parts cost.
Covered free under recall 11V-538 for affected cars. Check your VIN or ask an Infiniti dealer.
